We need answer Chinese law multiple choice. Need think. User asks: 《刑法》第115条第2款规定“过失犯前款罪的……”，属于____。 Options: A简单罪状 B叙明罪状 C空白罪状 D引证罪状. Need final line 答案：X.

We need analyze. Criminal law罪状 types: 简单罪状: only names crime, no description. 叙明罪状: describes constitutive elements. 引证罪状: refers to other clauses of same law to define crime. 空白罪状/空白: refers to other laws/regulations. "过失犯前款罪的" refers to preceding clause (前款罪), thus 引证罪状. Need answer D. Provide concise explanation maybe. Final line exactly.
content:
“过失犯前款罪的……”是通过引用同一法律条文中“前款”的规定来说明罪状，属于引证罪状。

答案：D
